paper_title: 3D template-based $Fermi$-LAT constraints on the diffuse supernova axion-like particle background
notes: Diffuse supernova ALP background constrained via 12 years of Fermi-LAT data. Benchmark 95% CL upper limit g_agamma < 3.76e-11 GeV^-1 for m_a << 10^-11 eV (mass-independent flat bound in this regime; encoded as horizontal line up to 10^-11 eV). Systematic scenario range spans [2.38, 7.04]e-11 GeV^-1.
